lines.text: On a blockchain, every payment is public.
Your balance. Who you pay. How much. Traceable — forever.
XORR changes that. Shield your U-S-D-C into a zero-knowledge note — only a commitment ever touches the chain. The amount stays invisible.
Now pay anyone — by email, a handle, or any address. The link between you: hidden.
Bring U-S-D-C in from Ethereum — bridged with a proof, with no link between deposit and claim.
And cash out to real fiat — a live off-ramp, straight to your bank.
Every spend — proven in zero knowledge, verified on-chain. XORR. Private money, made real.
